translations.web: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.
translations.bsb: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice; the nations scatter when You rise.
translations.kjv: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
translations.asv: At the noise of the tumult the peoples are fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations are scattered.
